changelog:
Clawpost 2.1.0 changelog:

- Added Instagram posting support (including media uploads).
- Added Reddit comment/reply via browser (no Reddit API key needed).
- Introduced MCP (Model Context Protocol) support with Streamable HTTP and OAuth for Claude, ChatGPT, and compatible agents.
- Expanded media capabilities: support for large file uploads via signed URLs.
- Updated onboarding: Chrome extension now pairs automatically with Google sign-in.
- Improved instructions and table of available endpoints/platforms.
summary: Secure, agent-native social posting — X, LinkedIn, Facebook Groups, TikTok, Instagram, plus Reddit comments in your browser. No platform credentials shared.
